en: Sepia-toned postcard showing a formal military parade in a city square. Uniformed officers with sashes and ceremonial swords march in formation; one officer walks prominently in the foreground. Multi‑storey neoclassical buildings line the background, with onlookers visible on balconies and rooftops. The caption at the top reads in French, and a website watermark and a small printed number appear at the bottom.
